New compact NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows PCs are also coming in October to give AI enthusiasts, developers and creators […]
history.content: Frontier intelligence is going local. At IFA 2026, NVIDIA, Microsoft and its partners are teaming up to provide faster inference and new tools that make agents easier to set up and run locally on NVIDIA hardware. New compact NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows PCs are also coming in October to give AI enthusiasts, developers and creators more ways to run capable agents locally and securely. Today’s announcements include: Simplified local AI support for NVIDIA GPUs is coming in Hermes Agent, OpenClaw and Perplexity Portable Computer. Up to 1.9x faster local inference — new llama.cpp and vLLM optimizations are available now directly and through LM Studio and Ollama. NVIDIA PAIR — a Personal AI Router tool that intelligently distributes AI inference across the PCs on a user’s local network. NVIDIA RTX Spark arrives in October — with new Windows PCs from Lenovo and Acer. Electronic Arts, Embark and Ubisoft are among the latest game publishers and developers bringing their blockbuster titles to NVIDIA RTX Spark. Also, August was a busy month for local AI: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning — which can run on NVIDIA RTX PCs, RTX PRO Workstations, DGX Spark and Jetson — is a 30-billion parameter model that has been launched. Get started with Nemotron 3.5 Lightning today. Z.ai’s GLM-5.3-Flash is a multimodal mixture-of-experts (MoE) model that’s bringing agentic AI to DGX Station. Qwen has released Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, an open weight multimodal MoE model, which can run locally on DGX Spark and DGX Station, along with Qwen3.8-27B, a 27-billion-parameter open model optimized for local agentic and coding workloads on NVIDIA GPUs. LTX’s LTX 2.5 is an open-world video generation model optimized for NVIDIA RTX GPUs, DGX Spark and DGX Station, with new NVFP4, FastVideo and ComfyUI enhancements for faster, more memory-efficient local generation. MiniMax-H3 is an open-weight video generation model with synchronized audio that can run locally on NVIDIA GPUs through ComfyUI. FastVideo teamed up with NVIDIA researchers to improve this further by releasing FastH3 — an open-weight, four-step distilled version that improves performance by 7x. Optimized FastVideo recipes for NVIDIA RTX GPUs and DGX Spark are coming soon. Meta’s Muse Glimmer is a 30-billion-parameter open-weight model for coding and agentic workloads that can run locally on GeForce RTX PCs, DGX Spark, DGX Station and Jetson. NVIDIA has also released NVFP4 quantization with DGX Spark support for more memory-efficient local deployment. DeepSeek v4 Flash is a 284-billion-parameter MoE model with 13 billion active parameters that can run locally on 2x DGX Spark cluster and DGX Station. A Simpler Start for Local Agents Getting a local agent up and running with local models required some effort — choosing a model, finding a compatible inference server, dialing in quantization settings and keeping everything updated. That friction is disappearing on RTX and DGX systems. Three of the most widely used agent apps will offer simplified local model setup on Windows, each built on llama.cpp and incorporating NVIDIA’s latest inference optimizations. The new setup experiences are designed to reduce manual configuration and make it easier to get local agents up and running. Last month, Perplexity introduced its Portable Computer agent, giving users a simple way to run Perplexity locally on Linux systems like NVIDIA DGX Spark with the models, orchestration and tools packaged into a single app experience. Perplexity Portable Computer is available on NVIDIA RTX GPUs with at least 24GB VRAM running on Linux, with support on Windows coming soon, bringing that same streamlined setup to a broader group of PC users. Users can run complete workflows locally without consuming credits, while selectively escalating parts of a task to one of 15+ frontier models in the cloud when additional research or reasoning is needed. Portable Computer asks for permission before sending content to the cloud, helping users keep sensitive information on their device. Here’s some example use-cases: Engineering: Review open PRs in a connected GitHub repo and sort them into ready, blocked, stale, and needs review, each tagged with the next step. Docs that fell out of sync with the latest merge get caught and fixed, with a PR opened for the changes. Finance: Point the agent at two years of brokerage summaries, consolidated 1099s and tax returns and have it trace the recurring holdings creating the most avoidable fees and tax drag, with every figure cited to the exact file and page — all without a document ever reaching a chatbot. Startups: Ask why activation went flat, and the agent analyzes the funnel export locally to find where new signups drop off between install and first completed task, then posts the top insights straight to the team’s Slack channel. Try Portable Computer today. Hermes Agent — developed by Nous Research — is a general-purpose agent used by millions that excels at reliability and self-improvement. Model- and provider-agnostic, Hermes is built to run all day on local systems, making RTX PCs, RTX PRO workstations and DGX Spark a natural fit. Configuring a local model in Hermes will provide users with one-click setup across RTX and DGX systems on Windows. The agent will automatically detect the NVIDIA GPU, select an appropriate model and configuration, and run it through integrated llama.cpp with NVIDIA inference optimizations already in place, eliminating manual model downloads and tuning. Support for Linux is coming soon. Once it is running, Hermes works the way it does anywhere else. It uses tools, maintains context across tasks, remembers information between sessions and creates reusable skills over time, allowing the agent to become more capable with continued use. Running the model locally on a GPU keeps performance fast while keeping data on the system. One-click local model setup is available now on Windows, with support coming soon to Linux. Learn more about Hermes Agent. OpenClaw has become one of the defining projects of the open-agent movement — the largest AI project on GitHub, with more than 380K stars and a fast-growing community that’s building tools and skills across research, engineering, project management and everyday productivity. NVIDIA, Microsoft and OpenClaw have been working together to make that experience easier to set up on Windows PCs. To reduce onboarding friction, the OpenClaw Windows App simplifies the process of setting up an optimized local model on any RTX GPU with at least 24GB of VRAM. Learn more in the OpenClaw blog. Faster Inference Gives Local Agents a Boost Inference performance is critical to keeping local agents responsive. NVIDIA is continuing to collaborate with the open-source llama.cpp and vLLM communities to accelerate agentic workloads across local NVIDIA platforms. llama.cpp delivers up to 1.9x higher throughput through kernel optimizations on a GeForce RTX 5090, enhanced speculative decoding techniques and faster prefill. ​ vLLM delivers 1.2x on RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition and up to 1.4x on two DGX Spark clusters. New XQA attention kernels in FlashInfer and backend optimizations help to accelerate inference across both platforms. These gains are available on the llama.cpp and vLLM inferencing backends. Users can also experience these via the LM Studio and Ollama applications. Tap Idle PCs for More Local AI Compute With NVIDIA PAIR More than half of U.S. households have two or more PCs, and much of that computing power sits idle throughout the day. NVIDIA Personal AI Router (PAIR) is a free, open source software tool that puts those systems to work together for local AI. Agentic workflows often break complex tasks into smaller jobs that can run in parallel, but performance can slow when every request is competing for the same GPU. PAIR automatically discovers compatible PCs on a local network and routes independent inference requests to whichever system has capacity. It works with Ollama and LM Studio and can adapt as devices join or leave the network. For example, a user could ask Hermes to create a “Sunday Reset” plan by sorting through a cluttered inbox and prioritizing what needs attention now, what can wait and what can be skipped. Hermes can split that work across multiple subagents, while PAIR distributes those jobs across available PCs instead of having them all wait on a single GPU. The result is more compute for local agents, with more tasks running in parallel and the flexibility to move AI workloads to another PC while the main system is being used for gaming, creating or other work. The NVIDIA PAIR beta is available for Windows, macOS and Linux through both graphical and terminal interfaces, supporting NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20 Series GPUs and newer, NVIDIA RTX PRO workstation GPUs (Turing architecture and newer), NVIDIA DGX Spark and Apple M4 or newer silicon. Check out the NVIDIA tech blog to get started with NVIDIA PAIR. Powerful On Device Photo Editing With Cyberlink PhotoDirector AI PC Mode on RTX Spark Open image and video models enable artists to experiment with Creative AI models on PCs. This enables artists to iterate and explore concepts and ideas, without the dreaded token anxiety and keep more of their creative work private and on-device. CyberLink’s new PhotoDirector AI PC Mode is one of the first applications to integrate these diffusion models directly into a creative software, and turn them into a creative tool at the finger tips of the artists. Coming to PhotoDirector 365 and optimized for NVIDIA RTX Spark when it launches, AI PC Mode users are getting AI-powered editing tools for generative editing, image enhancement, object and distraction removal, background removal and replacement, portrait refinement and the creation of entirely new visuals — with the flexibility to choose between local or cloud processing, depending on the task. On NVIDIA GPUs, PhotoDirector uses TensorRT-RTX and FP8 to accelerate local AI. Start using Cyberlink’s PhotoDirector 365 photo editing software and learn more about PhotoDirector AI PC Mode, launching with RTX Spark in October. NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows PCs Arrive October 2026 NVIDIA RTX Spark is coming this October— and at IFA 2026, partners are showing off their hardware. At IFA, newly announced designs join the existing six OEMs shipping in October. Acer showed its compact desktop RTX Spark concept, and Lenovo announced its Yoga Pro 9n and Yoga 9n 2-in-1. RTX Spark is a new beginning for Windows PCs. One PC built for creators, gamers and AI agents. With a powerful 1 Petaflop RTX Blackwell GPU, up to 128GB of unified memory and a highly efficient 20-core Grace CPU, RTX Spark delivers incredible performance and efficiency. This superchip enables high performance thin laptops with all day battery life and compact desktops to power always-on agents. Paired with the new Windows Agent framework, it enables agents that run safely in the background under OS level control. Last week at Gamescom, Electronic Arts, Embark and Ubisoft were among the latest game publishers and developers bringing their blockbuster titles to NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows PCs. They join the publishers that announced RTX Spark support at COMPUTEX in May, including KRAFTON, NetEase, Riot Games and XBOX. Read more. Sign up to be notified when RTX Spark laptops and desktops are available. #ICYMI: More Updates From NVIDIA Local AI 🎮 NVIDIA Brings New RTX Tech and Games to Gamescom — NVIDIA released DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction, featuring a new second-generation transformer model for improved image quality in ray-traced and path-traced games. Gamescom also brought new RTX announcements for titles including 007 First Light, CONTROL Resonant and Gears of War: E-Day, plus expanded game support for the upcoming NVIDIA RTX Spark. 🐋Introducing DeepSeek Harness — DeepSeek’s new open source harness pairs with DeepSeek-V4-Flash to power local agentic coding workflows on NVIDIA DGX Station and multi-DGX Spark setups. 📊MLPerf Client v2.0 Expands AI PC Benchmarking — MLCommons released MLPerf Client v2.0, developed in collaboration with NVIDIA and other industry leaders. The update adds new benchmarks for agentic AI and image generation, alongside expanded LLM testing for real-world local AI workloads. Follow NVIDIA RTX Spark on X, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook — and stay informed by subscribing to the NVIDIA Local AI newsletter. Follow NVIDIA Workstation on LinkedIn and X. history.descriptionZh:
在IFA 2026上，NVIDIA联合微软及合作伙伴推出了一系列旨在让“前沿智能走向本地”的更新：通过更快的推理性能、更易用的AI代理（agent）工具以及不断扩大的本地模型生态，把过去依赖云端的强大模型能力带到个人电脑、工作站和桌面设备上。整个发布的核心是NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows PC，这款紧凑型设备将于2026年10月上市，联想和宏碁已在展会上公布相关机型。

**本地AI代理配置门槛大幅降低**

过去要让本地AI代理跑起来并不容易：用户需要自己挑选模型、寻找兼容的推理服务器、反复调整量化参数，还要手动维护更新。RTX和DGX系统如今正在消除这些摩擦。三个被广泛使用的代理应用——Hermes Agent、OpenClaw和Perplexity Portable Computer——都基于llama.cpp并集成了NVIDIA的最新推理优化，在Windows上提供简化模型设置，减少手动配置步骤。

其中，用于数百万用户的通用代理Hermes Agent由Nous Research开发，强调可靠性与自我改进能力。Hermes本身模型无关、提供商无关，可以全天候运行在本地系统中，尤其适合RTX PC、RTX PRO工作站和DGX Spark。现在在Windows上，Hermes支持一键设置：它会自动检测NVIDIA GPU，选择合适模型和配置，并通过内置的llama.cpp直接运行，免去手动下载模型和调优的环节；Linux支持即将到来。本地GPU运行既保证了速度，又将数据留在设备上。

Perplexity Portable Computer是Perplexity上月推出的代理产品，原本面向Linux系统、可在NVIDIA DGX Spark上运行，将模型、编排和工具打包成单一应用体验；现在它已支持配备至少24GB显存的NVIDIA RTX GPU上的Linux系统，Windows支持也即将推出。用户可以完全在本地运行完整工作流而不消耗API积分，仅在需要额外研究或推理时，有选择地把某个任务片段上传到云端15多个前沿模型之一。所有云端发送请求都会先征得用户许可，方便保护敏感信息。文中列举了实际用例：工程师让它审查GitHub仓库中的开放PR并把任务归为待处理、阻断、陈旧或待评审；财务人员让它分析两年券商账单、合并1099表和税单，追踪产生最多冗余费用和税负的持仓，并精确到文件和页码；创业团队让它分析漏斗导出数据，找出从安装到完成首个任务之间的流失环节，再把洞察直接发到Slack。

OpenClaw则是开源代理运动中最具代表性的项目之一，是GitHub上规模最大的AI项目，已获得超过38万颗星，社区围绕研究、工程、项目管理等场景快速成长。NVIDIA、微软和OpenClaw团队合作降低了其在Windows PC上的配置门槛：OpenClaw Windows应用现在可以简化在任何配备至少24GB显存的RTX GPU上的本地模型配置流程。

**推理性能大幅提速**

代理的响应速度高度依赖推理性能。NVIDIA继续与开源llama.cpp和vLLM社区合作，优化本地NVIDIA平台上的代理工作负载。llama.cpp通过内核优化、增强投机采样和更快的prefill阶段，在GeForce RTX 5090上实现了最高1.9倍的吞吐量提升。vLLM则在RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell工作站版上带来1.2倍提升，在双DGX Spark集群上最高提升1.4倍。这些增益来自FlashInfer中新的XQA注意力内核以及后端的综合优化。目前相关优化已直接可用的，也可以通过LM Studio和Ollama应用体验。

**NVIDIA PAIR：让局域网内闲置PC参与本地推理**

调查显示超过一半的美国家庭拥有两台以上PC，但这些算力在一天中大部分时间是闲置的。NVIDIA Personal AI Router（PAIR）是一款免费开源软件，可以把这些系统组织起来，共同执行本地AI任务。代理工作流经常把复杂任务分解成可以并行的小任务，如果所有请求都挤在同一块GPU上，性能就会下降。PAIR会主动发现局域网内兼容的PC，并把相互独立的推理请求路由到有算力余量的系统中。它支持Ollama和LM Studio，并能动态适应设备加入或离开网络。

举例来说，用户可以让Hermes制作一份“周日重置”计划：整理混乱的收件箱，区分哪些需要立即处理、哪些可等待、哪些直接跳过。Hermes会把工作拆给多个子代理，而PAIR则把这些子任务分配到多台PC上并行执行，而不必全部排队等待一块GPU。最终，本地代理获得更多算力，更多任务可以并行运行；当主系统用于游戏或创作时，AI负载也可以被灵活转移到另一台PC。PAIR beta版已支持Windows、macOS和Linux，提供图形与终端界面，兼容NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20系列及以上、RTX PRO工作站GPU（图灵架构及以上）、DGX Spark，以及Apple M4或更新芯片。

**创意软件拥抱本地生成式AI：PhotoDirector AI PC Mode**

本地开放图像与视频模型让艺术家可以摆脱“token焦虑”，在PC上探索创意概念，并把更多创作内容保留在设备端。CyberLink新推出的PhotoDirector AI PC Mode是首批将这些扩散模型直接集成到商业创作软件中的产品之一。该功能将随PhotoDirector 365提供，并在RTX Spark发布时进行优化。AI PC Mode提供生成式编辑、图像增强、物体与干扰物移除、背景替换、人像精修、全新视觉内容创作等能力，同时允许用户按任务灵活选择本地或云端处理。在NVIDIA GPU上，PhotoDirector使用TensorRT-RTX和FP8加速本地AI处理。该模式预计于10月与RTX Spark一同登场。

**RTX Spark Windows PC：10月落地，游戏与代理双管齐下**

RTX Spark被定义为Windows PC的一个新起点——一台同时面向创作者、游戏玩家和AI代理的设备。它集成了算力达1 petaflop的RTX Blackwell GPU、最高128GB统一内存以及20核Grace CPU，高效能与低功耗兼顾。这颗超级芯片既能放进高性能超薄笔记本中实现全天候续航，也能让紧凑型台式机稳定运行始终在线的AI代理。在IFA 2026上，宏碁展示了紧凑型台式机的RTX Spark概念机，联想则发布了Yoga Pro 9n和Yoga 9n二合一笔记本。RTX Spark还将配合全新的Windows Agent框架，让代理在操作系统级控制下的后台安全运行。游戏生态方面，上周在Gamescom上，Electronic Arts、Embark和育碧等发行商和开发商宣布将其大作带到RTX Spark Windows PC；此前在COMPUTEX上，KRAFTON、网易、Riot Games和Xbox等已宣布支持。

**2026年8月本地AI模型与工具集中爆发**

过去一个月里，本地AI模型生态也相当活跃。NVIDIA发布可运行在RTX PC、RTX PRO工作站、DGX Spark和Jetson上的Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，这是一个300亿参数的模型。Z.ai的GLM-5.3-Flash是一款多模态混合专家（MoE）模型，将代理AI引入DGX Station。阿里Qwen发布开放权重的多模态MoE模型Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，可在DGX Spark和DGX Station上本地运行；同步亮相的Qwen3.8-27B是270亿参数的开放模型，专为NVIDIA GPU上的本地代理和编码工作负载优化。LTX推出面向NVIDIA RTX GPU、DGX Spark和DGX Station优化的开放世界视频生成模型LTX 2.5，新增NVFP4、FastVideo和ComfyUI增强，能更快、更省显存地完成本地视频生成。MiniMax-H3是可同步生成音频的开放权重视频生成模型，可通过ComfyUI在NVIDIA GPU上本地运行；FastVideo团队与NVIDIA研究者合作推出四步蒸馏版本FastH3，性能提升7倍，针对RTX GPU和DGX Spark的优化FastVideo配方也即将发布。Meta发布的Muse Glimmer是300亿参数开放权重模型，专为编码和代理工作负载设计，可在GeForce RTX PC、DGX Spark、DGX Station和Jetson上本地运行。DeepSeek v4 Flash则是拥有2840亿参数、130亿激活参数的MoE模型，可在双DGX Spark集群和DGX Station上本地部署。NVIDIA还发布了支持DGX Spark的NVFP4量化，进一步降低本地部署的内存需求。

此外，NVIDIA在Gamescom上发布了DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction，利用第二代Transformer模型改善光线追踪和路径追踪游戏画面；DeepSeek发布了开源工具DeepSeek Harness，与DeepSeek-V4-Flash配合可在DGX Station和多DGX Spark环境中驱动本地代理编码工作流；MLCommons联合NVIDIA等企业发布了MLPerf Client v2.0基准测试，新增代理AI和图像生成的测试项目，并扩展了面向真实本地AI负载的LLM测试。可以看到，无论是硬件、系统软件、模型还是创意工具，NVIDIA正在与合作伙伴一起把“本地AI”从开发者玩法变成面向主流用户的高效、安全、可控的智能计算方式。

history.title: Lenovo’s IdeaPad Vibe laptops stand out with seven colors and swappable keycaps – 14,15-inch models with Snapdragon X and AMD AI 400 CPUs to start at $699
history.description: Lenovo’s latest IdeaPad laptops are all about colorful vibes. The Vibe lineup will come in seven hues, with swappable keyboard keycaps so you can match the chassis or go for a pop of contrast. The 14- and 15-inch laptops will land later this year, starting at $699.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The arrival of the MacBook Neo seems to have reminded other PC makers that people like color (and relative affordability), and the IdeaPad Vibe line appears to be Lenovo’s answer to both. Starting at $699 when they arrive later this year and offered in 14- or 15-inch screen sizes, the laptops will feature seven color options and either an all-metal chassis or a metal lid and keyboard deck, with a plastic bottom. In a twist, the company will also offer swappable keycaps (pretty uncommon in the laptop space) that can either match your laptop’s color or veer away from it for some striking contrast.Lenovo says the laptops will start at 1.3kg (2.87 pounds), offer up to 24GB or 32GB of RAM (more with the AMD-based models, where you can also opt for a larger 65 WHr battery), and feature either 120 Hz IPS or OLED screens. Oddly, the OLED options will only be offered in the most subdued hues – lowkey gray and moody blue. Image 1 of 2 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 2 View Original Image 2 of 2 View Original Internally, the Vibes feature two M.2 SSD slots and will be offered with either Qualcomm’s Snapdragon X or AMD’s Ryzen AI 400, and a 50 WHr battery as standard. Lenovo easily beats the MacBook Neo and Dell’s XPS 13 on ports, offering two USB Type-A and two Type-C ports (though they are all capped at 5 GB/s), along with HDMI, a headphone jack, and a microSD card slot.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Of course, given that both the AMD and Qualcomm chips feature prominent NPUs, Lenovo is also pushing its cross-platform Qira AI (also offered in Motorola phones), which the company says “features Workato-powered connections such as email, calendar, and collaboration services, helping users find relevant information and move from intent to action through natural-language requests with less app switching.” (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Lenovo notes that Qira will only be offered “on select configurations,” and RAM is listed across the lineup simply as “up to 24GB.” Given the high price of memory these days, the $699 starting configs will almost certainly ship with just 8GB of RAM. So don’t expect the lower-end configurations to be particularly friendly when it comes to local AI tasks. You may like Dell's new 14-inch laptops take on the MacBook Neo in a new way Lenovo ditches fans in favor of solid-state AirJet tech in super-slim, 1.8-pound AeroBlade laptop concept Lenovo details its RTX Spark laptops Lenovo says the AMD-based IdeaPad Vibe laptops will arrive first, starting in October, while Snapdragon models will land in November. And the company promises Intel options as well, arriving at an as-yet undisclosed date. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)If you like the colors offered on the Vibe line, but don’t need portability, Lenovo will also be offering its IdeaCentre AIO i with Intel Core Series 3 CPUs and a 27-inch screen in similar colors. It will ship with a matching keyboard and mouse, starting at $939 in November.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors Follow Tom's Hardware on Google News, or add us as a preferred source, to get our latest news, analysis, & reviews in your feeds.

history.titleZh: 联想IdeaPad Vibe笔记本以七种配色和可换键帽脱颖而出——配备骁龙X和AMD AI 400处理器的14、15英寸机型起售价699美元
history.descriptionZh:
联想推出全新IdeaPad Vibe系列笔记本电脑，显然是为了应对传闻中MacBook Neo带来的竞争压力。在不少PC厂商意识到市场对多彩外观和亲民价格存在强烈需求后，联想选择以这一新系列同时回应这两个痛点。新机预计今年晚些时候上市，起售价699美元，提供14英寸和15英寸两种屏幕尺寸。外观方面，Vibe系列提供多达七种配色选项，并采用两种机身方案：一种是全金属机身，另一种则是金属顶盖与键盘底座搭配塑料底部，降低了入手门槛。更值得注意的是，联想还带来笔记本领域少见的可拆换键帽设计，用户既可以选配与机身同色的键帽保持统一，也可混搭不同颜色制造视觉对比，满足个性化需求。

核心配置上，联想宣称该系列起始重量仅为1.3公斤（约2.87磅），内存最高可选24GB或32GB，其中AMD版本容量上限更高，还可选配65Whr大容量电池，而标准配置则内置50Whr电池。屏幕部分搭载120Hz刷新率IPS面板或OLED屏，不过略为特别的是，OLED版本仅出现在灰色和蓝色两款相对低调的配色上。内部存储方面，Vibe拥有两个M.2 SSD插槽供扩展。处理器平台则分为高通骁龙X与AMD Ryzen AI 400两款，均带有高性能NPU（神经网络处理单元）。端口配置是其一大亮点，联想借此轻松胜过MacBook Neo和戴尔XPS 13：提供两个USB Type-A接口和两个Type-C接口，虽然所有接口带宽均限制在5GB/s，但依然额外保留了HDMI、耳机插孔以及microSD卡槽，实用性更全面。

在AI体验方面，联想大力推广其跨平台AI助手Qira（同样已整合进摩托罗拉手机中）。据官方介绍，Qira集成了基于Workato的连接功能，能够打通电子邮件、日历及协作服务，让用户通过自然语言指令快速找到所需信息并完成操作，减少在应用间反复切换的麻烦，实现从意图到行动的高效转化。不过，联想也明确指出Qira仅会出现在部分配置机型上，并非全系标配。内存方面，由于当前内存价格高企，699美元起步版本几乎可以确定只会搭载8GB内存——这意味着低配机型在本地运行AI任务时可能会显得力不从心，有意使用AI能力较强的用户需要关注更高阶的配置。

发售节奏上，联想表示基于AMD平台的IdeaPad Vibe将率先于10月上市，高通骁龙版本紧随其后在11月推出，而Intel处理器版本也已确认规划中，具体时间尚未公布。如果喜欢Vibe系列的色彩设计但不需要便携性，联想还会推出IdeaCentre AIO i一体机，搭载Intel Core Series 3 CPU与27英寸屏幕，同样采用类似配色，并附赠同色系键鼠套装，11月起售，起价939美元。总体来看，联想通过IdeaPad Vibe系列在色彩定制、接口数量和平台多样性上形成了差异化卖点，意图在主流轻薄本市场中抢占更多份额。

history.title: Lenovo details its RTX Spark laptops — Yoga Pro 9n and Yoga 9n 2-in-1 get full specs, stylus support
history.description: Lenovo detailed its RTX Spark laptops ahead of IFA in Berlin, releasing full specs and showing off stylus compatibility.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Lenovo is providing a full spec list for the Yoga Pro 9n, the Nvidia RTX Spark-powered laptop it announced at Computex, and has a second Spark system ahead of IFA: the Yoga 9n 2-in-1, a 16-inch convertible.Both systems are listed as using Grace CPUs with up to 20 Cores and Blackwell RTX graphics with up to 6,144 cores, suggesting there will be multiple RTX Spark chips to choose from for both systems. history.author: Andrew E. Freedman
history.titleZh: Lenovo details its RTX Spark laptops — Yoga Pro 9n and Yoga 9n 2-in-1 get full specs, stylus support
history.descriptionZh:
联想在Computex 2025上首次展示搭载Nvidia RTX Spark平台的笔记本后，如今又进一步公布了其中一款产品——Yoga Pro 9n的完整规格，并在IFA展会前夕提前曝光了第二款RTX Spark设备：16英寸可翻转屏二合一笔记本Yoga 9n 2-in-1。这两款产品共同展现了联想与Nvidia在AI PC和新型处理器架构上的深度合作，也首次让外界较为完整地看到RTX Spark平台的实际产品形态和技术特性。

RTX Spark是Nvidia进军PC市场的新方案，它并非传统意义上的独立显卡加CPU组合，而是将Grace架构的CPU与Blackwell架构的RTX GPU集成在同一颗芯片中，并采用统一内存架构。联想公布的两款新机均采用这一平台，其中Grace CPU最多配备20个核心，Blackwell RTX集成GPU最多拥有6144个核心。由于规格选项不同，意味着RTX Spark系列将有多个芯片型号供OEM厂商选用。这种CPU与GPU融合、共享内存的设计，一方面可以降低系统复杂度和功耗，另一方面让AI模型所需的大容量内存可以直接被GPU访问，从而避免数据在传统独立显存和系统内存之间来回拷贝的开销。

具体到内存配置上，Yoga Pro 9n作为传统翻盖式笔记本，最高可搭配128GB的LPDDR5x-9400统一内存；而Yoga 9n 2-in-1的上限则为64GB。存储方面也体现出两者的定位差异：Yoga Pro 9n拥有两个SSD插槽，总容量最高可达4TB，并且规格表中没有强调存储介质的类型，暗示可能采用更高端的TLC或PCIe Gen5方案；而Yoga 9n 2-in-1则明确使用了看似等级较低的QLC SSD，最大仅为2TB PCIe Gen4容量，其中一个插槽为M.2 2242规格。这种区分表明联想在努力控制二合一的成本和厚度，而将性能释放留给专业向的Pro机型。

在性能释放上，Yoga Pro 9n的15.3英寸版本TDP最高达到80W，这也是我们首次听到关于RTX Spark系统官方TDP的确切数值。虽然Nvidia尚未公布各个RTX Spark芯片的具体功耗区间，但80W对于一款集成CPU和GPU的移动处理器来说已属可观，足以应对中型AI推理、3D渲染和游戏负载。二合一产品的TDP信息暂未披露，但考虑到体积和散热限制，预计会比Pro机型略低。

屏幕方面，两款产品都采用了联想PureSight Pro OLED面板。Yoga Pro 9n配备15.3英寸、分辨率为2560×1600的OLED屏，支持从48Hz到165Hz的可变刷新率；Yoga 9n 2-in-1则为更大的16英寸OLED屏，分辨率提升至2880×1800，刷新率范围30Hz到120Hz。两者均支持VRR、16:10比例，以及高达1100尼特的HDR峰值亮度。对于创作者而言，高亮度HDR OLED是色彩准确性和对比度的关键；可变刷新率则可在轻负载时降低功耗，在游戏和视频中保持流畅。

设计上，两款机器都采用全黑金属机身，结合反光和哑光材质，虽然这是联想Yoga系列的传统风格，但以往多为深蓝色。Yoga 9n 2-in-1特别回归了联想多年前停用的一种设计——将soundbar音响集成于铰链之中。这样无论屏幕处于笔记本模式、帐篷模式还是平板模式，扬声器都能朝向前方或上方，保证声音清晰，对二合一设备而言是颇为实用的设计。

两款机型都配备9.2MP的MIPI摄像头，并支持IR人脸识别。值得注意的是，该摄像头直接连接到处理器而非传统USB/PCIe控制器，这在使用Nvidia的ISP和AI图像处理算法时，可更高效地进行背景虚化、自动取景等特性；同时两者均支持Wi-Fi 7和蓝牙5.4，网络连接也处于当前消费电子的一线规格。电池容量各有不同：Yoga Pro 9n为92.5Wh，而Yoga 9n 2-in-1则为99.9Wh，后者由于是16英寸大屏二合一，重量也达到1.94公斤，Pro机型则轻至1.65公斤。

从产品定位来看，联想将Yoga Pro 9n打造为一款面向AI工作的“生产力机器”。借助RTX Spark内置的CUDA软件生态，联想宣称可以在本地运行越来越复杂的AI模型，无需联网或数据上传云端。Windows 11系统即将支持更多代理型AI功能，例如OpenClaw和Hermes，这些智能体会利用Nvidia的openShell工具以及Windows自身的分层安全机制，在本地自动执行多步任务，包括操作文件、调用应用、协调工作流等。联想的宣传中也明确列出了游戏、开发、视频编辑和渲染等使用场景，值得注意的是，其触控板具备压感并支持数字笔输入，可辅助精确创作。尽管属于联想高端消费系列，但Yoga Pro 9n的规格与性能实际上已接近移动工作站的范畴。

相比而言，Yoga 9n 2-in-1则更侧重“创意工具”方向。触控屏配合Yoga Pen Gen 2手写笔，让用户可以自由地进行绘画、草图或笔记。联想在世界级的AI创作工作流中强调了ComfyUI和Adobe Premiere Pro等软件对AI的支持，同时也提到了LTX和FLUX两种本地模型。LTX是基于物理空间视频渲染的新模型，能够生成与真实时空状态相符的视频内容；FLUX则是当前较为流行的文本到图像模型。这些模型通常需要数十GB的GPU内存才能流畅运行，而RTX Spark的统一内存架构，特别是二合一的64GB配置依然可以较为从容地支持，这也凸显了Nvidia在这一平台上的核心卖点：在单芯片上获得足以驾驭生成式AI的内存带宽与容量。

联想尚未公布这两款机的具体价格和上市时间。新闻稿中仅说明价格将于正式发布时揭晓，但未给出具体日期。Nvidia此前已经表示，RTX Spark会在今年秋季正式推出，因此预计这两款Yoga产品届时会同步上市，并可能与更多笔记本品牌一同出现在市场中。

总体而言，联想Yoga Pro 9n和Yoga 9n 2-in-1是RTX Spark这一全新计算平台的重要落地产品。它们不仅让外界首次完整看到该平台在CPU核心数、GPU规模、内存上限、TDP等关键维度上的实际表现，也展示了Nvidia如何通过Grace与Blackwell的融合，将PC真正推向“本地AI”时代。无论是128GB统一内存的AI工作站级别超便携本，还是64GB内存内置手写笔与铰链音响的创意二合一，都预示着PC形态与芯片架构之间正在发生一场基于AI负载的重新整合。随着秋季发布临近，市场上将有更多可供选择的RTX Spark设备推出，而Nvidia能否撼动英特尔和AMD在PC处理器市场中的既有地位，将是2025年下半年最值得关注的芯片话题之一。

在柏林IFA展会前夕，英伟达做出了这一宣布，联想和宏碁随即展示了搭载N1X的新设备：联想推出了Yoga 9n二合一笔记本，宏碁则发布了采用该芯片的紧凑型迷你台式机，目前两者均未公布定价。后续华硕、戴尔、MSI、惠普以及微软也将推出相关产品——微软今年在Computex上已经展示了旗舰级Surface Laptop Ultra。这些设备被定位为面向“智能体AI”的主力工具，英伟达也在演示中展示了其游戏性能，但实际表现仍有待测试。官方还承诺“全天续航”，这一说法同样需要实机验证。

英伟达的统一内存架构与苹果M系列芯片（包括最近发布的M6和M5 Ultra）的理念相似，两者都基于Arm指令集。在x86阵营中，AMD的Strix Halo（及未来的Gorgon Halo）同样采用了统一内存。N1X的上市还将打破高通对Windows on Arm生态的独占，为这一平台引入重量级新芯片供应商，并可能吸引更多希望利用英伟达开发工具的应用开发者达成合作。

history.title: Nvidia PAIR utility joins every GPU in your home into a cluster for agentic AI tasks — tool uses spare cycles to keep agent swarms from hammering one GPU
history.description: Nvidia's Personal AI Router (PAIR) clustering utility lets agentic AI workloads take advantage of every spare GPU cycle on a home network, potentially making  for faster execution and more private inference.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter If you're a token-hungry AI enthusiast, and if you or your family happen to have PCs with idle GPU cycles to spare in this economy, Nvidia wants to make it possible to harness those cycles so you can save cash on cloud tokens and keep your work private. At IFA 2026, the company is introducing a local distributed AI clustering tool called the Personal AI Router (PAIR) that dispatches agentic AI sub-tasks from your main PC to systems on your home network that have suitable GPU cycles to spare.As Nvidia tells it, when a user runs a local AI agent and gives it a goal to complete, that central agent might then spawn several sub-tasks carved out of that larger goal. If those sub-tasks or sub-agents are all running on the same GPU, the contention they create might cause the task to finish more slowly than it could if each sub-agent had a dedicated compute node to work with.PAIR is a tool that can make that distributed AI work happen on a home network. Assuming that a family or shared household is sufficiently flush with idle GPU resources, PAIR canYEa assign each participating system one of those sub-tasks to perform and return the results to the main node, potentially resulting in faster completion of the larger agentic task.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Of course, systems on your local network won't always be idle. Their owners will frequently use the GPUs in their systems for gaming, creative work, or AI tasks of their own. If a user needs their GPU back, PAIR purports to gracefully deal with those changing conditions. It doesn't reserve dedicated capacity from other PCs; it's elastic by design and will make the best of the resources available to it at any given moment.This unpredictable availability of spare cycles does, of course, mean that quality of service is not assured from a PAIR cluster. But for long-running tasks that don't need to be done on a strict deadline, being able to put spare compute to work could still be more effective than running an agent swarm on a single node. You may like Startups want to rent your idle gaming PC for AI tasks Nvidia reveals AI robots that taught themselves to install GPUs into motherboards AI cryptomining network's 320,000 RTX 3090-class GPUs allegedly burn 112 megawatts of power on ‘zero useful AI computation’ PAIR sounds relatively simple to set up. It creates a proxy for popular AI front-ends like LM Studio and Ollama to connect to. PAIR then orchestrates work across available nodes on the network and returns the results of that work to the originating application on the head node.In turn, participating PAIR nodes also need to be running Ollama or LM Studio and have a PAIR installation of their own. Nvidia says that enrolling systems in a PAIR cluster is straightforward and relies on mDNS or an IP address fallback for discovery. PAIR will also help initiate model downloads on participating systems, but Nvidia says that nodes don’t need to have identical models or sets of models downloaded to participate.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsIf more systems do have a given model available, though, it broadens the pool of potential nodes that can handle a request if the orchestrator agent needs a particular model’s capabilities.PAIR will run on any DGX Spark (or other GB10) box, as well as GeForce RTX 20-series graphics cards or newer. It also supports Macs with M4-series processors or newer for inference. Accordingly, the PAIR client will be available for Windows, macOS, and Linux. history.titleZh: Nvidia PAIR utility joins every GPU in your home into a cluster for agentic AI tasks — tool uses spare cycles to keep agent swarms from hammering one GPU
history.descriptionZh:
在IFA 2026上，Nvidia推出了一款名为“Personal AI Router（PAIR）”的本地分布式AI集群工具，旨在让普通家庭用户利用家中多台PC的空闲GPU算力，协同完成复杂的AI智能体（agentic AI）任务。这一工具的出现，直接回应了当前云端AI token费用高昂、数据隐私难以保障的痛点，使个人用户无需依赖云端即可获得更强的本地AI计算能力。

PAIR的核心创新在于它解决了一个很实际的问题：当用户在本地运行一个大型AI智能体时，这个主智能体会将宏大目标分解为多个子任务或子智能体。如果所有这些子任务都挤在同一块GPU上运行，资源争抢会显著拖慢整体完成速度。PAIR的作用正是在家庭局域网内实现分布式调度——它假设一个家庭或共享住所有多台带有闲置GPU周期的电脑，PAIR会将各个子任务分配到不同的参与节点上并行执行，再将结果汇总回主节点，从而大幅缩短完成时间。

在实际运行中，PAIR的设计具有很强的弹性。它不会为某些PC预留专用算力，而是动态感知各节点GPU的闲置情况。当某个家庭成员需要收回GPU用于游戏、创作或其他AI任务时，PAIR能够“优雅地”适应这种变化，随时利用当前可用的资源。当然，这也意味着PAIR集群无法保证稳定的服务质量，但对于没有严格截止期限的长时任务而言，利用碎片化闲置算力仍然比在一台机器上运行整个智能体群更高效。这一思路也与一些初创公司“租用闲置游戏PC跑AI”的理念相似，但PAIR更强调本地化、隐私保护和自部署。

设置方面，PAIR力求简单。它会为LM Studio、Ollama这类常见的AI前端创建一个代理接口，使这些应用可直接连接到PAIR。PAIR随后在网络中编排各可用节点的任务分配，并将结果回传给发起请求的主机应用。每一台参与节点需要运行Ollama或LM Studio，并安装PAIR自身。节点发现机制基于mDNS协议，若不可用则回退到IP地址直接指定。Nvidia还表示，PAIR可以帮助参与设备自动下载所需模型，但节点无需下载完全相同的模型库——只要某个节点拥有某模型，它就能在编排器需要该模型能力时加入任务池。模型在更多节点上的冗余存在，反而扩大了可处理特定请求的候选节点范围。

硬件支持方面，PAIR可运行在DGX Spark或其他GB10平台上，也支持GeForce RTX 20系列及更新的显卡，同时支持搭载M4系列及更新芯片的Mac用于推理。客户端软件覆盖Windows、macOS和Linux。这意味着，闲置旧电脑和游戏机也能被纳入AI算力网络。在应用场景上，PAIR适合本地部署AI助手、多智能体协同任务、本地内容生成和科研计算等场景，尤其适合重视数据隐私的用户和希望降低云端依赖的开发者。通过将家庭中“沉睡”的GPU资源转化为可用的AI算力池，PAIR进一步推动了边缘AI与个人算力民主化的进程。

history.content: Nvidia is announcing its new Personal AI Router (PAIR), a free tool that syncs up your home computers for tackling local AI inference tasks with tools like Ollama and LM Studio.Let’s get the obvious thing out of the way, despite what its name might imply: PAIR is not a hardware router. It’s open-source software developed by Nvidia that discovers compatible PCs on a network, connects them, and prepares them for crunching numbers on agentic workflows. While the compatible devices are mostly Nvidia GeForce GPUs (PAIR works with RTX 20-series cards and newer, as well as RTX Pro GPUs and DGX Spark systems), Apple’s M4 chips or newer will also work.The key thing here is that PAIR uses your in-home systems when they’re idle to avoid interfering with other tasks. And this disaggregated system of computers can work in parallel to chew through lots of processing requests — which should be helpful for an agentic workflow that breaks complex tasks into smaller jobs. This should prevent large bottlenecks on a single GPU, and Nvidia says PAIR can adapt as devices join or leave the network — including if a user does something like start playing a game on their desktop PC.PreviousNext1/2Nvidia PAIR’s graphical interface in action. Image: NvidiaIn a media briefing, Nvidia product manager Seth Schneider painted a picture of a household filled with powerful computers that could be doing much more with PAIR: a dad with both an Nvidia RTX Spark laptop and a DGX Spark desktop, a mom with an RTX 5090 laptop, a daughter with a gaming desktop, and a son with a MacBook Pro. In this incredibly extreme case, Schneider estimates this house has about 165 teraflops of underutilized compute. “It’s truly a treasure trove of free tokens just sitting in homes today,” he says, even when accounting for the electricity costs in the average American home.Nvidia says PAIR is secured by pairing all devices through a six-digit code and then securing the channel via mTLS (Mutual Transport Layer Security), to create an encrypted communication line that’s trusted in both directions between computers. The Nvidia PAIR beta is available today, with support for Windows, Linux, and macOS.The structure of Nvidia PAIR. Image: NvidiaPAIR does seem like a clever solution if you already have some beefy computers in your home and you want to run your own local AI. Upon my asking who PAIR is really for, and what kind of setups are actually realistic, Schneider said Nvidia envisions most PAIR users will have something like one MacBook or Windows laptop and one gaming PC.In addition to PAIR, Nvidia is also announcing that three major AI agent apps — Perplexity Portable Computer, Hermes Agent, and OpenClaw — will offer simplified local setup with Nvidia GPUs on Windows. The new setup experiences are designed to allow users to get local agents up and running in just a few clicks, reducing the initial manual configuration necessary.

history.titleZh: 英伟达推出免费工具，将闲置电脑连成个人AI数据中心
history.descriptionZh:
英伟达近日发布了一款名为“个人AI路由器”（Personal AI Router，简称PAIR）的全新工具。尽管名称容易让人联想到硬件设备，但PAIR并非实体路由器，而是一款由英伟达开发的免费开源软件。其核心功能是自动发现家庭网络中兼容的计算机设备，将其连接并整合起来，共同承担本地AI推理任务，支持与Ollama、LM Studio等本地AI工具协同工作。

在技术原理层面，PAIR解决的是家庭多设备算力碎片化的问题。现代家庭中往往拥有多台性能不俗的电脑，但在多数时间处于闲置状态，算力被白白浪费。PAIR能够在网络中发现这些兼容PC，将其组成一个“去中心化”的计算集群，以并行方式协同处理大量推理请求。这种架构对于智能体工作流（agentic workflows）尤其有价值——这类工作流通常会将复杂任务分解为多个子任务，PAIR可以将不同子任务分发到不同设备上并行执行，从而有效避免单块GPU上的性能瓶颈。系统还具备动态适应能力，能够实时响应设备加入或离开网络的情况。例如，当某位家庭成员启动游戏导致桌面PC负载升高时，PAIR会自动将该设备从推理任务中摘除，确保不影响用户的正常使用。

兼容性方面，PAIR主要支持英伟达GeForce RTX 20系列及更新型号的GPU，同时也兼容RTX Pro GPU和DGX Spark系统。此外，苹果M4芯片及更新版本的设备也可参与其中。软件目前以测试版形式发布，支持Windows、Linux和macOS三大平台。

英伟达产品经理Seth Schneider在媒体简报中描绘了一个典型应用场景：假设一个家庭中，父亲拥有Nvidia RTX Spark笔记本和DGX Spark台式机，母亲使用RTX 5090笔记本，女儿有一台游戏台式机，儿子使用MacBook Pro——这个家庭的闲置总算力高达约165万亿次浮点运算（teraflops）。Schneider形容这是“家中沉睡的真正免费token宝库”，即便将美国家庭平均电费成本计算在内，利用这些闲置算力的经济性仍然极为可观。他指出，英伟达预期的典型用户画像并非如此极端的设备大户，而是“一台MacBook或Windows笔记本加一台游戏PC”的普通配置。

安全机制方面，PAIR采用了双重保障：所有设备首先通过六位数字码进行配对认证，随后利用mTLS（双向传输层安全协议）建立加密通信通道，确保设备间传输的数据在双向都经过身份验证和加密保护。

除PAIR外，英伟达还同时宣布了三款主流AI智能体应用——Perplexity Portable Computer、Hermes Agent和OpenClaw——将提供基于英伟达GPU的Windows平台简化本地部署体验。这些应用通过全新的设置流程，让用户只需几次点击即可在本地启动并运行AI智能体，大幅减少了传统上繁琐的手动配置步骤。

PAIR的推出反映了边缘AI部署正在从单设备模式向多设备协同模式演进。对于关注数据隐私、希望摆脱云端依赖的用户而言，这种能够调动家庭存量算力的方案提供了一个颇具吸引力的本地推理基础设施选择。

history.titleZh: 密苏里州一城市近70%选民投票罢免支持AI数据中心税收减免的市议员——该议员称不应因一个问题上的分歧就让他下台
history.descriptionZh:
美国密苏里州独立市（Independence）近日举行了一场特别罢免选举，市议员约翰·珀金斯（John Perkins）以68.05%的反对票被正式罢免，失去市议会席位。这场政治风波的核心导火索，是珀金斯此前投票支持向人工智能基础设施运营商Nebius提供超过60亿美元的税收减免，以换取该公司在当地建造大型数据中心。报道指出，珀金斯是当时五名投赞成票的市议员之一，而随着他的落马，这五名支持者中已有三人因此失去公职——此前，寻求连任市议员的贾里德·费尔斯（Jared Fears）和竞选市长的布里奇特·麦坎德利斯（Bridget McCandless）也在各自的选举中败北。

事情的起因可以追溯到今年3月的市议会会议。当时，大量社区成员在会议前持续抗议这一开发项目，但市议会最终仍以5比2的投票结果，批准了针对Nebius数据中心的税收优惠方案。抗议活动在“停止独立市AI数据中心”的Facebook群组中组织得尤为活跃。在罢免结果出炉后，该群组成员公开表示：“政治家并不天然拥有民选职位。他们由人民选出是为了服务人民。当他们不再服务选民时，就会被投票赶下台，这就是民主的实际运作。”虽然珀金斯尚未对罢免结果公开发表声明，但他此前曾在《堪萨斯城星报》的专栏文章中捍卫自己的决定，强调支持Nebius税收减免是正确选择，并警告罢免他将使城市发展倒退。他写道：“你可以不同意这个决定，我尊重这一点。然而，分歧不是犯罪，我也不认为这足以成为推翻两年前一场选举的理由。一次投票不应该抹去我此前为所在选区所做的辛苦工作。”

值得注意的是，尽管罢免珀金斯的支持率极高，这次特别选举的投票率却低得惊人。杰克逊县共有14,250名登记选民，但实际前往投票所表达支持或反对的仅有1,643人，投票率只有11.5%。这一数据意味着，珀金斯的罢免实际上是极少数积极参与者的意见表达——尽管这在制度上是合法的民主程序。

此次事件并非孤例。在美国，围绕AI数据中心的社区冲突正在迅速蔓延。密苏里州另一个城市费斯图斯（Festus）也出现了类似局面：由于市议会批准了一项占地360英亩的数据中心项目，今年4月的例行选举中，八名市议员中有四名被选民罢免。虽然当地曾发起请愿书试图继续罢免余下四名议员，但该动议最终被市议会否决。

从全美范围来看，公众对数据中心的态度正在急剧转变。目前，针对数据中心开发的禁令和暂停措施已超过500项，散布在各个城镇、县乃至州级行政单位。一个特别值得关注的现象是，这类抵制行动跨越了政治立场和党派归属——无论是左翼还是右翼选民，都出现了反对数据中心的强烈声音。这种跨阵营的普遍反对给超大规模云服务商和AI基础设施企业带来了巨大阻力，使新建项目从选址到审批变得愈发艰难。这一趋势也折射出AI热潮落地过程中日益尖锐的矛盾：一边是科技巨头对算力基础设施的迫切需求，另一边是普通民众对能源消耗、水资源占用、环境噪音和社区形态变化的深切担忧。

history.description: Sam Altman says that a single almond uses up more water than 38,000 ChatGPT queries. He said that the concerns of people about data centers using up so much water are nothing but a "robust meme," and that the claim doesn't hold up to any scrutiny.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 9 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has downplayed the water consumption issue that AI data centers are facing, saying that it has been blown out of proportion over time and does not keep up with the latest developments in data center cooling technology. Altman said this in an episode of the Sources Podcast with Alex Heath, where the two talk about the backlash against AI development. He claimed that producing a single almond in California is equivalent to 38,000 ChatGPT queries. Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsible“You know, I saw this thing going around about the water usage of ChatGPT. And it was like every time you run a single ChatGPT query, it’s like, you know, you run your shower for like six hours. And the water never comes back, and it’s just done. I don’t have the exact calculation in front of me, but I think the real number is something like — doing this from memory, it might be wrong, but it’s close — for every 38,000 ChatGPT queries, that is the same amount of water that is used in the production of a single almond in California… This is like the full-on, you know, total true water accounting, not just what’s running in one data center,” Altman told the host.SAM ALTMAN: “For every 38,000 ChatGPT queries, that is the same amount of water that is used in the production of a single almond in California.” pic.twitter.com/vRCCPneJSmSeptember 2, 2026“There’s a question of like where this came from because the people that are scarfing down 12 almonds at a time don’t feel like they’re doing something horrible from a water perspective, for the most part. It is true that data centers at one point used evaporative cooling, but they have not done that in a long time. Like if you look at a modern very large data center, it uses the equivalent amount of water as an office building in terms of, you know, people like running the sinks and the toilets and whatever. So, that has been a robust meme and difficult to disprove, but I don’t think it holds up to any scrutiny.”Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: It’s true that almonds are some of the most water-intensive crops being grown in the U.S. Researchers say that it takes about 1.1 gallons of water to grow a single almond. By comparison, Altman's own statements in the past indicate that one ChatGPT response uses somewhere between 1 to 50mL of water, ostensibly using older evaporative cooling techniques, or about 0.0002 to 0.013 gallons per query. While this is nowhere near Altman’s 38,000 estimate, it’s still about 85 to 5,500 ChatGPT queries per almond using an unspecified cooling method. Nevertheless, training AI models in older facilities can use far more water, with estimates suggesting that GPT-3 used up almost 185,000 gallons of water with older systems, while the increasing popularity of AI, especially AI agents which use up a lot more tokens than just chatbots, means that data centers could still use more water compared to almond farming.In fact, multiple data centers across the United States have faced issues with their water consumption, with one site in Fayette County, Georgia, using up 29 million gallons over a span of 15 months and another development in Morgan County, Georgia, allegedly causing the water of its neighbors to turn muddy. Altman admitted that data centers that used older technologies like evaporative cooling used a lot of water, but he also mentioned that new techniques and technologies have been developed that cut down data center water use. Some examples of this include Nvidia’s liquid cooling system that runs “hotter than a hot tub,” which cuts water use by 100%, and Microsoft’s closed-loop cooling systems, which use the same amount of water as a restaurant. Amazon even claimed that its data centers consume only 0.075% of the water that Americans use for their lawns and gardens. history.titleZh: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says 38,000 ChatGPT queries use as much water as the production of one almond — says data centers use no more water than an office building
history.descriptionZh:
OpenAI首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼（Sam Altman）近日在《Sources Podcast》节目中回应了外界对AI数据中心水资源消耗的批评，他认为这一担忧被“严重夸大”了，并且未能跟上数据冷却技术的最新进展。在与主持人亚历克斯·希斯（Alex Heath）的对话中，奥尔特曼特别反驳了此前流传的“每次ChatGPT查询相当于让淋浴喷头连续开6小时”的说法，称这种类比缺乏依据。他给出的对比是：在加州，生产一颗杏仁所消耗的水量，大约相当于运行3.8万次ChatGPT查询。他强调这是“完整、真实的水账”，不只是单个数据中心内的直接用水。

针对“水被蒸发后不再回来”的担忧，奥尔特曼指出，数据中心过去确实使用蒸发冷却技术，但现代大型数据中心早已不再如此。他举例说，一个现代化超大规模数据中心的用水量，已和一座普通办公楼相当（主要用于洗手间、水槽等日常用途）。他认为“AI耗水”是一个很难被推翻的流行迷因，但经不起任何严肃推敲。

然而，Tom's Hardware的文章也梳理了相关数据细节，显示问题并非如此简单。事实是：杏仁确实是美国耗水量最高的作物之一，据研究，每生产一颗杏仁大约需要1.1加仑（约4.2升）水。而根据奥尔特曼过往的表述，一次ChatGPT回答在旧式蒸发冷却条件下大约耗水1至50毫升（约0.0002至0.013加仑）。按此计算，一颗杏仁的耗水量相当于85至5500次ChatGPT查询——远低于他所说的3.8万次。不过，若使用不同冷却方式或更高强度计算，数字会有所不同。此外，旧设施中训练AI模型的水耗更为惊人：据估计，训练GPT-3在旧系统下曾消耗近18.5万加仑（约70万升）水。而且随着AI普及，AI代理（agent）类应用消耗的token远多于普通对话，数据中心的总用水量仍可能超过杏仁种植。

文章还列举了美国多地数据中心因用水引发的真实纠纷：佐治亚州费耶特县一座设施在15个月内用掉2900万加仑水；摩根县另一项目甚至导致附近居民井水变浑浊。奥尔特曼承认，采用蒸发冷却等旧技术的设施确实耗水巨大，但他强调新技术已大幅削减数据中心的用水需求。例如，英伟达的液冷系统运行温度“比热水浴缸还高”，可将冷却用水降低100%；微软的闭环冷却系统的用水量约等于一家餐厅；亚马逊则称其数据中心用水量仅相当于美国人用于浇灌草坪和花园水量的0.075%。

这篇报道同时指出，多数美国新建AI数据中心正选址在干旱地区，且有预测到2030年AI领域年耗水量可能高达6000亿加仑。奥尔特曼的回应似乎意在平息舆论，但业界和公众仍应审慎评估数据中心的真实水足迹——尤其是考虑到训练环节与推理环节的水耗差异，以及不同冷却技术实际部署的规模和速度。值得注意的是，美国AI芯片出口规则的频繁变动以及数据中心CPU需求的激增（部分由AI代理驱动）也在加剧对水电资源的需求。奥尔特曼的完整播客内容可在线观看，他在其中还讨论了OpenAI的下一代模型以及AI发展所遭遇的社会反弹。

history.title: Benchmarking 31 different CPUs in Onimusha: Way of the Sword — X3D beats flagships by 10%, 270K Plus falls behind Raptor Lake Refresh
history.description: Onimusha: Way of the Sword closes out an excellent year for Capcom. We put the RE Engine to the test once again, benchmarking 31 different CPUs to see how they scale in the game.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 6 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Onimusha: Way of the Sword closes out an incredible year for Capcom, following hot on the heels of both Resident Evil Requiem and Pragmata earlier in the year. Like those titles, the game is built on Capcom’s proprietary RE Engine, which has proven to be a remarkably scalable engine that can accommodate a wide range of hardware. We put some of the best CPUs for gaming through the game’s free benchmark to see how it scales on the CPU.RE Engine is heavier on the GPU than the CPU, but still, we saw scaling across the 31 CPUs we tested, ranging from new releases like the Core Ultra 7 270K Plus, reaching back to relics of the past decade like the Ryzen 7 2700X. Largely, performance falls as you’d expect, but there were a few odd results that showed up in our testing, namely for AMD’s newer 12-core Ryzen 9 models, which struggle to keep pace in this game.Regardless, the game runs well on a wide range of hardware. Even with the RTX 5090 Founder’s Edition we tested with the Ryzen 7 2700X, completely binding performance to the CPU, we neared 90 FPS at 1080p with Ultra settings and no ray tracing.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: This is a cursory look at Onimusha: Way of the Sword using the in-game benchmark available (we’ll go over how we tested a bit later). As usual, performance will vary from scene to scene, and we’ve yet to reach the latest areas of the game, which may have an adverse impact on performance (though we don’t expect one). We are looking at how CPUs scale in the game more so than the raw frame rate of any individual chip.CPU scaling in Onimusha: Way of the SwordThe Onimusha: Way of the Sword benchmark is about five minutes long, primarily consisting of two in-engine cutscenes rendered in real time. The back half of the benchmark features gameplay, which shows considerably lower performance and taxes the CPU far more than the cutscenes. We chose to benchmark during the gameplay section, naturally. You may like Intel Core Ultra 7 270K Plus vs AMD Ryzen 7 7700X3D faceoff — battle of the upper mid-range CPUs CPU Benchmarks and Hierarchy 2026: CPU Rankings The Best CPU for Gaming in 2026 We tested with the Ultra preset without ray tracing enabled. We didn’t use DLSS or FSR, either. As usual, we tested at 1080p with the RTX 5090 Founder’s Edition to isolate CPU performance as much as possible. We’ll go deeper into the specific system configuration for each platform later in this article if you’re interested. For each CPU, we ran the benchmark three times and took the median result, discarding and rerunning any outliers. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Out of the 31 CPUs we tested, the obvious ones to call out first are AMD’s 12-core Ryzen 9 offerings, because they perform poorly in this game. The Ryzen 9 7900X is actually 3% slower than the Ryzen 5 7600X, and similarly, the Ryzen 9 9900X is 1% behind the Ryzen 5 9600X. There’s clearly some issue with the 12-core parts, specifically, that doesn’t show up in the single-CCD Ryzen CPUs, nor the full, 16-core, dual-CCD models.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsGreat evidence of that is the Ryzen 9 7900X3D, which I only chose to run to see if 3D V-Cache would be able to overcome the 12-core penalty. It wasn’t able to. Every other X3D chip we tested sits at the top of the charts, while the Ryzen 9 7900X3D ended up in lockstep with the Ryzen 7 7700X. It’s possible this is a performance issue that either Capcom will address through a patch, or AMD through a firmware update. Regardless, the 12-core Ryzen 9 performance in this game is rough right now.Elsewhere, things are great. X3D chips top the charts, though with less of a margin than we see in other titles, and virtually no margin in comparison to one another. The Ryzen 7 7700X3D is 7.2% ahead of the Core i9-14900K, Intel’s strongest CPU in this game, while the Ryzen 7 9800X3D extends that lead up to 11.3%. We didn’t have time to benchmark the Ryzen 7 9850X3D, though based on the negligible performance gap between the 7700X3D and 7800X3D, don’t expect any miracles.The Ryzen 7 5800X3D doesn’t reach the heights of its DDR5-equipped siblings, falling 13.4% behind the Ryzen 7 7800X3D. It still puts on an excellent showing considering its peers, sitting among the Core Ultra 9 285K and Ryzen 9 9950X. Even four years down the road, the Ryzen 7 5800X3D delivers performance on the level of current-gen flagships, at least in this title. What to read next AMD Ryzen 7 5800X3D vs Intel Core i7-14700K faceoff — A new battle for DDR4 supremacy in 2026 AMD Ryzen 7 7700X3D review: A slower 7800X3D, but not necessarily a cheaper one AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D vs Ryzen 7 7700X3D faceoff In Intel’s camp, the Core i9-14900K remains the fastest chip in Onimusha, at least when equipped with DDR5 (read our DDR4 vs DDR5 Raptor Lake comparison to see the difference in performance). Unfortunately for Team Blue, even the Core i7-14700K is 2.9% faster than Intel’s latest Core Ultra 7 270K Plus in this game. Intel doesn’t have support for Onimusha with iBOT, nor any RE Engine titles, suggesting that the performance you see here is the cap for Arrow Lake Refresh. Hopefully that changes with Intel’s impending Nova Lake.Although Arrow Lake and AL Refresh don’t scale as high as the 14th-Gen offerings, performance is still solid competitively. The Core Ultra 5 245K is in lockstep with the Ryzen 5 9600X, as expected, while the lowly Core Ultra 5 225 is nipping at the heels of the Ryzen 5 7600X. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Flipping over to power, X3D chips remain well under 100W, short of the dual-CCD, dual-cache Ryzen 9 9950X3D2. Intel’s Raptor Lake Refresh chips unsurprisingly had the highest power usage out of our test pool, with the Core i7-14700K actually drawing a bit more power than the Core i9-14900K. Although we ran the test multiple times, we took the median result for average frame rate, which can sometimes push neighboring figures out of sorts when looking at other metrics. We don’t want to mix power results from one run and performance from another. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Looking directly at efficiency, the Ryzen 7 7700X3D was the most efficient chip in our testing, offering up just over 3.5 frames per watt consumed. The Ryzen 7 7800X3D barely offered a performance benefit over the 7700X3D, so its efficiency suffers as a result. Even the Ryzen 7 9800X3D falls below the 3-frames-per-watt mark. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Finally, clock speed doesn’t offer a lot of surprises. The more efficient CPUs like the Ryzen 7 7800X3D ran right up against their maximum boost clock on average, while flagships that push single-core speed to the limit like the Ryzen 9 9950X and Core i9-14900K fall below their maximum boosts. Clocks don’t translate into performance here, though looking at this chart combined with our averages provides some insight into how threaded Onimusha is.It’s lightly threaded, like the vast majority of games, though there’s a clear bump in performance beyond four cores. Combined with lower maximum boost clocks on high-core-count flagships, all-core clocks are certainly more relevant here than single-core boosts. Then again, clock speed isn’t a major factor here, regardless.How we tested Onimusha: Way of the SwordWe used our normal test bench used for CPU reviews, as well as our CPU benchmark hierarchy testing. The hardware doesn’t change, short of the CPU and, when necessary, the motherboard and memory. We also use a frozen OS image, meaning we’re running the same versions of the same software with all the same dependencies for each test pass.The GPU we used is the RTX 5090 Founder’s Edition, as our goal when looking at CPU scaling is to isolate the CPU’s performance as much as reasonably possible. Naturally, running a game at a low resolution like 720p and turning down all of the graphics options will put even more pressure on the CPU, but that pushes beyond isolating the performance of one component in a relatively realistic testing environment.Intel LGA 1851 (Arrow Lake and Refresh) Swipe to scroll horizontally Intel LGA 1851 (Arrow Lake and Refresh) Row 0 - Cell 1 Motherboard ASRock Z890 Taichi RAM 2x16GB G.Skill Trident Z Neo RGB DDR5-7200 Intel LGA 1700 (Raptor Lake, Alder Lake) Row 3 - Cell 1 Motherboard MSI MPG Z790 Carbon Wi-Fi RAM 2x16GB G.Skill Trident Z Neo RGB DDR5-7200 AMD AM5 (Zen 5, Zen 4) Row 6 - Cell 1 Motherboard MSI MPG X870E Carbon Wi-Fi, Gigabyte Aorus X870E Elite X3D ICE RAM 2x16GB G.Skill Trident Z Neo RGB DDR5-6000 AMD AM4 (Zen 3) Row 9 - Cell 1 Motherboard Asus TUF Gaming X570-Pro Wi-Fi Row 11 - Cell 0 4x8GB G.Skill Trident Z RGB DDR4-3200 All Systems Row 12 - Cell 1 Gaming CPU Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 Founder’s Edition Application GPU Nvidia GeForce RTX 2080 Ti Founder’s Edition Cooler Corsair iCue Link H150i RGB Storage 2TB Sabrent Rocket 4 Plus PSU MSI MPG A1000GS, Gigabyte UD1000GM PG5 V2 Other Arctic MX-4 TIM, Windows 11 Pro, Alamengda open test bench Although the hardware is consistent, there are BIOS tweaks we make depending on the platform. As a broad rule, anything we enable that improves performance is covered under warranty. If performance-enhancing features void the warranty, we leave them disabled. That includes AMD’s Precision Boost Overdrive and Intel’s Extreme power profile. We also don’t enable any motherboard-specific performance enhancements, such as tweaked XMP/EXPO profiles or X3D enhancements.For this test pool, there are some features still covered by the warranty that improve performance. In Intel’s camp, we tested with Core Ultra 200S Boost enabled on all supported Arrow Lake CPUs (the 225 doesn’t support the feature). Similarly, the Ryzen 5 9600X and Ryzen 7 9700X run at a 65W TDP out of the box, but an optional, warrantied 105W TDP mode is available. We tested with that mode enabled.We also disabled Virtualization-Based Security (VBS), as it can adversely affect gaming performance. history.titleZh: Benchmarking 31 different CPUs in Onimusha: Way of the Sword — X3D beats flagships by 10%, 270K Plus falls behind Raptor Lake Refresh
history.descriptionZh:
Capcom在2026年迎来了产品线的密集发布期，《鬼武者：剑之道》紧随《生化危机：安魂曲》和《Pragmata》的脚步推出。与前述作品一致，该作同样基于Capcom自研的RE Engine开发。这一引擎在硬件适配性方面展现了高度的可扩展性，促使Tom's Hardware利用游戏内置基准测试，对31款CPU进行了详细的扩展性评测。尽管RE引擎整体负载偏向GPU，CPU端的表现差异依然显著，测试中甚至出现了若干异常有趣的结果。

本次评测选取的基准场景约5分钟，前半部分为实时渲染的引擎内过场动画，后半部分为实际游玩画面。游戏场景的帧数明显低于过场动画，对CPU的负载也更大，因此成绩取样集中在游戏环节。测试统一采用Ultra画质预设，关闭光线追踪、DLSS和FSR，在1080p分辨率下搭配RTX 5090 Founder's Edition显卡，以最大限度将性能瓶颈锁定在CPU上。每款处理器均完整运行三次基准，取中位数成绩，离群值则重新测试。平台按代际分为Intel LGA 1851、LGA 1700以及AMD AM5、AM4等几套方案，内存分别搭配DDR5-7200、DDR5-6000和DDR4-3200。凡属保修范围内的性能增强功能均予开启，例如Arrow Lake处理器的Core Ultra 200S Boost以及锐龙5 9600X/锐龙7 9700X可选的105W TDP模式，同时关闭了可能干扰游戏性能的VBS功能。

评测结果中最突出的问题是AMD 12核锐龙9型号的反常表现。锐龙9 7900X实际比锐龙5 7600X慢3%，锐龙9 9900X也比锐龙5 9600X落后1%。这一缺陷仅出现在12核双CCD型号上，单CCD锐龙及完整16核双CCD型号均未显现。为验证3D V-Cache能否弥补这一惩罚，评测还专门加入了锐龙9 7900X3D，但缓存并未解决问题，其性能与锐龙7 7700X基本持平。作者推测该问题有望通过Capcom补丁或AMD固件更新得到修复。

排除上述特例后，整体格局符合预期。X3D系列芯片依旧占据榜首，但领先幅度小于多数其他游戏，且各型号之间差距极小。以Intel阵营在该作中最强的Core i9-14900K为基准，锐龙7 7700X3D领先7.2%，锐龙7 9800X3D则将优势扩大至11.3%。评测未能覆盖尚未送测的锐龙7 9850X3D，考虑到7700X3D与7800X3D之间微乎其微的性能差，作者并不看好其带来突破性提升。值得注意的是，基于DDR4平台的锐龙7 5800X3D虽比7800X3D低13.4%，却仍与Core Ultra 9 285K及锐龙9 9950X处于同一水平——在平台问世四年后依旧能对标当代旗舰，堪称亮眼。

Intel方面，搭载DDR5的Core i9-14900K依旧是该阵营在该游戏中的性能顶点，甚至Core i7-14700K也比最新的Core Ultra 7 270K Plus快了2.9%。当前Intel的iBOT技术尚不支持RE Engine游戏，这意味着现有成绩基本代表了Arrow Lake Refresh的性能上限，后续改善寄望于Nova Lake。中端方面，Core Ultra 5 245K与锐龙5 9600X表现持平，入门级Core Ultra 5 225则紧咬锐龙5 7600X。整体来看，游戏在广泛硬件上都能流畅运行：即便使用锐龙7 2700X这种近十年前的老将搭配RTX 5090，在CPU完全成为瓶颈的情况下，1080p Ultra无光追设置依旧能逼近90帧。

功耗与能效方面，X3D芯片功耗普遍维持在100W以下，但双CCD双缓存的锐龙9 9950X3D2是个例外。Intel Raptor Lake Refresh毫无悬念地成为功耗大户，Core i7-14700K的功耗甚至略高于Core i9-14900K。为保证数据严谨性，帧率中位数与来自同一次运行的功耗数据配对使用，以避免不同轮次间的干扰。能效比层面，锐龙7 7700X3D以超过3.5帧/瓦的成绩成为测试中最节能的产品；锐龙7 7800X3D由于性能增益微弱能效反而下降；锐龙7 9800X3D也未能突破3帧/瓦大关。

从频率特征观察，能效优异的锐龙7 7800X3D平均运行频率几乎贴着最高加速频率，而以单核极限见长的锐龙9 9950X与Core i9-14900K则明显低于各自最大加速频率。该作属于典型的轻线程负载游戏，但性能在四核以上仍有清晰跃升；结合高核心数旗舰普遍较低的加速频率来看，全核频率比单核最高频率对实际帧率影响更大，不过总体而言频率并非帧数的决定性因素。

history.content: Nvidia has agreed to buy Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, bringing one of the most popular hosting platforms for open-source AI models, datasets, and tools under the ownership of the world’s biggest AI chipmaker.Hugging Face is an online platform founded in 2016 that gives AI developers a space to share their projects and data with other users and the general public. It’s often described as the “GitHub” for AI due to its browsable library of open-source machine learning models and emphasis on community collaboration features.“Together, we will scale Hugging Face’s platform, strengthen its infrastructure and expand access to AI for developers and institutions worldwide,” Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said in his announcement. “Hugging Face will remain an open platform for the entire AI ecosystem. Developers will choose the models they want, the frameworks they want, the clouds and inference service providers they want and the computing platforms they want. Nvidia compute will not be required to build on or deploy through Hugging Face.”Speculation regarding a potential Hugging Face acquisition started on August 23rd, after Business Insider reported that the startup was working with a bank to explore options for a $13 billion sale. By August 27th, Business Insider reported that Nvidia had been having acquisition conversations with Hugging Face over the previous week, though an earlier report by The Information said that a $12.9 billion deal between the companies had already been agreed upon.RelatedNvidia’s new financial strategy does not computeHugging Face is being used to easily undress women and childrenWe’re running out of reasons to ignore AI safetyWhile these reports couldn’t be independently verified at the time, Nvidia has now publicly declared its intentions to purchase the open-source AI repository. With open-source developers currently racing to catch up with closed AI systems, Nvidia stands to gain a strategic foothold to help preserve its AI hardware dominance now that closed-source AI providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google are attempting to produce their own AI chips.The last official valuation Hugging Face had was $4.5 billion, off the back of a funding round in 2023 that Nvidia participated in. The Financial Times previously reported that Hugging Face rejected a $500 million investment offer from Nvidia last year that would have valued it at $7 billion, apparently expressing concerns over having a single, dominant investor.The startup isn’t a significant money-maker, however. The Information reports that Hugging Face has recently been generating around $150 million in annualized revenue, barely a fraction of its purchase price. That said, as the world’s most valuable public company, Nvidia sure has a lot of money to throw around right now, and it seems happy to do so to protect the AI empire it’s been building.

history.titleZh: 英伟达以近130亿美元收购Hugging Face
history.descriptionZh:
英伟达（Nvidia）已达成协议，以129.3亿美元收购开源AI模型托管平台Hugging Face。这意味着全球最大的AI芯片制造商将把最受欢迎的开源AI模型、数据集与工具社区收入囊中。

Hugging Face成立于2016年，是一个供AI开发者与公众分享项目、数据和模型的在线平台。由于拥有可浏览的开源机器学习模型库，并强调社区协作功能，它常被形容为“AI领域的GitHub”。英伟达CEO黄仁勋在声明中表示：“我们将共同扩展Hugging Face的平台，增强其基础设施，并扩大全球开发者和机构获取AI的机会。Hugging Face仍将是整个AI生态系统的开放平台。开发者可以自由选择他们想要的模型、框架、云服务、推理服务提供商以及计算平台。基于Hugging Face构建或部署并不强制要求使用英伟达的计算资源。”

收购传闻始于8月23日，当时有报道称Hugging Face正与银行接洽，探讨以约130亿美元出售的可能。随后在8月27日，有消息透露英伟达在过去一周内与Hugging Face展开了收购谈判，最终英伟达公开确认了收购意图。此前，一些观点认为，随着开源开发者努力追赶闭源AI系统，英伟达此次交易是为了在OpenAI、Anthropic和Google等闭源AI供应商尝试自研AI芯片之际，获得一个战略支点，以巩固自身在AI硬件市场的主导地位。

Hugging Face上一轮公开估值为45亿美元，该轮融资发生于2023年，英伟达也参与了投资。据《金融时报》报道，Hugging Face去年曾拒绝了英伟达5亿美元的投资要约，该要约对应的估值为70亿美元，当时公司似乎对拥有单一主导投资者有所顾虑。从财务表现看，Hugging Face并非一家利润丰厚的企业。据The Information报道，其近期年化收入约为1.5亿美元，与129.3亿美元的收购价相比只是很小一部分。不过，作为全球市值最高的上市公司，英伟达目前拥有充足的资金，似乎也愿意通过大手笔收购来保护其正在构建的AI帝国。

history.title: RPCS3 emulator devs slam Nvidia DLSS 5 as 'AI-slop generator' — says industry pushing 'more upscalers and frame generation to hallucinate games and hide their lack of optimisation'
history.description: RPCS3 explains why modern temporal upscalers are difficult to implement in PS3 emulation as modders continue experimenting with the leaked DLSS 5 DLL.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 11 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Developers at RPCS3, the open-source PlayStation 3 emulator, have criticized Nvidia’s DLSS 5 technology, calling it an “AI-slop generator.” A number of modders managed to port DLSS 5 to various games last week after the latest neural-rendering tech leaked before the official launch. A few people also went ahead and apparently tested the leaked DLSS 5 DLL on the RPCS3 renderer. According to a post by the official RPCS3 account on X, “Whilst the gaming industry pushes more upscalers and frame generation to hallucinate games and hide their lack of optimisation, we do not ship any of that slop.”The post has drawn criticism from certain users, with one calling RPCS3’s response “possibly the dumbest” they could have expected. They argued that DLSS and FSR frame generation can complement game-engine optimizations rather than simply mask poor performance, while Nvidia’s Reflex can help mitigate the latency penalty associated with frame generation.DLSS 5 on RPCS3?A few people are testing a leaked DLSS 5 DLL on our renderer. We have seen the slop it generates.Whilst the gaming industry pushes more upscalers and frame generation to hallucinate games and hide their lack of optimisation, we do not ship any of that slop. pic.twitter.com/S2GciNbCTKSeptember 1, 2026In its response, RPCS3 said that emulators have never-ending goals, and they do not simply target high-end hardware to achieve playable status. The developers also added that modern temporal upscalers are difficult to implement because PS3-era games do not expose the motion-vector data they require. At the same time, RPCS3’s low-level RSX emulation makes reconstructing that data impractical. As a result, the emulator currently relies on spatial upscalers such as FSR 1, bilinear, and nearest-neighbor scaling.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: DLSS 5 is expected to officially roll out starting today, with NBA2K27 being the first game to support the latest tech. Focusing on 3D-guided neural rendering, DLSS 5 aims to deliver movie-grade visual realism and photorealistic lighting in games. The AI model is trained to deduce how complex features of game scenes like characters, skin, hair, and environmental lighting should look in the real world given certain inputs from the game engine, like color buffer and motion vectors, in combination with an input frame. According to Nvidia, DLSS 5 will also provide different AI models and controls, allowing artists to decide what gets enhanced, where the effect appears, and how strongly it is applied. For players, however, Nvidia wants to keep things simple as DLSS 5 essentially becomes an on/off graphics option, while the detailed decisions about how the AI-generated visual effects are used are handled by the game developer.Since DLSS 5 is resource-intensive, gamers should expect a noticeable drop in frame rates, especially with the initial release. Nvidia has also confirmed that DLSS 5 will only be compatible with RTX 50-series desktop and mobile GPUs, as well as GeForce Now. Notably, the recently leaked DLL has allowed some modders to successfully port DLSS 5 to older RTX 40-series cards. history.titleZh: RPCS3 emulator devs slam Nvidia DLSS 5 as 'AI-slop generator' — says industry pushing 'more upscalers and frame generation to hallucinate games and hide their lack of optimisation'
history.descriptionZh:
RPCS3 开源 PlayStation 3 模拟器的开发者日前公开抨击了 Nvidia 的 DLSS 5 技术，并将其称为“AI 垃圾生成器”（AI-slop generator），在游戏社区引发广泛争议。事情的起因是，DLSS 5 在正式发布前发生泄漏，一些 MOD 作者迅速将其 DLL 文件移植到了多款游戏当中，还有人尝试在 RPCS3 模拟器的渲染器中运行这套泄露的 DLSS 5。模拟器官方账号随即在 X 平台发文称：“当游戏行业不断推动更多升频器和帧生成技术，试图用‘幻觉’来粉饰游戏并掩盖其缺乏优化的事实时，我们绝不会提供任何此类垃圾。”这条推文附带了测试截图，直观展示了 DLSS 5 在 PS3 游戏画面中产生的伪影和错误细节。

RPCS3 的强硬态度很快引发用户反驳。有人指出这一回应“可能是最愚蠢的”，认为 DLSS 和 FSR 帧生成并非只能掩盖糟糕的性能，而是可以补充游戏引擎的现有优化；同时 Nvidia 的 Reflex 低延迟技术也能有效抵消帧生成带来的输入延迟增加。在后续回复中，RPCS3 开发者解释称，模拟器的优化目标是永无止境的，不能只依赖高端硬件来达到可玩状态。他们强调，现代时域（temporal）升频器难以应用于 PS3 游戏，因为那个时代的游戏并不向外暴露 DLSS 这类技术所需的运动矢量（motion vector）数据，而 RPCS3 采用的低层级 RSX 图形模拟方式也使重建这些数据变得极不现实。因此，该模拟器目前仍依赖 FSR 1、双线性插值和最近邻缩放等空间（spatial）升频方案。

这场争论恰好发生在 DLSS 5 正式登场的时间点。Nvidia 原定于本周起正式推送 DLSS 5，首款支持该技术的游戏将是《NBA 2K27》。DLSS 5 的核心创新并非传统意义上的超分辨率，而是聚焦于“3D 引导神经渲染”（3D-guided neural rendering），目标是实现电影级的画面真实感和照片级光照效果。其 AI 模型会结合游戏引擎提供的输入——如颜色缓冲（color buffer）、运动矢量以及当前帧——来推断游戏场景中复杂特征在真实世界里应有的样子，包括角色造型、皮肤、毛发以及环境光照等。Nvidia 同时强调，DLSS 5 提供了多种 AI 模型和精细控制项，允许美术开发者决定画面中的哪些内容需要增强、增强出现在哪些区域，以及效果的强度如何。但对于普通玩家，Nvidia 选择简化体验：DLSS 5 本质上只是一个“开/关”式的画质选项，具体如何使用 AI 生成视觉效果则由游戏开发者全权掌控。

需要指出的是，DLSS 5 是资源密集型技术。Nvidia 已提醒玩家，开启该功能后游戏帧率会出现明显下降，尤其是初版驱动和实现中。兼容性方面，DLSS 5 仅支持 RTX 50 系列桌面及移动 GPU，以及 GeForce Now 云游戏平台。不过，此次泄露的 DLL 文件已被部分 MOD 作者成功移植到较旧的 RTX 40 系列显卡上运行，使得老一代硬件也能部分体验这一新技术——尽管这并非 Nvidia 的官方支持路径。整体而言，这段插曲折射出游戏行业中关于 AI 渲染技术的深刻分歧：一边是 Nvidia 等厂商将神经渲染视为下一代画面革新的核心，另一边则以 RPCS3 这类模拟器项目为代表，坚持认为这些技术掩盖了游戏开发层面的效率问题，并不适合所有场景。对于追求真实画面的玩家来说，DLSS 5 所带来的视觉飞跃与帧率代价、以及其对高端硬件的苛刻要求，仍需要在实际应用中权衡。
